chunks: 2462 - He said: And I heard him say:

Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام gifted four horses from Yemen to the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله. Then he came to him and said, “O Messenger of Allah, I have gifted you four horses.” He said, “Describe them.” He said, “They are of different colors.” He said, “Is there among them one with white markings?” He said, “Yes.” He said, “Is there among them a chestnut with white markings?” He said, “Yes.” He said, “Then keep it for me.” And he said, “Are there among them two bay horses with white markings?” He said, “Give them to your two sons.” He said, “And the fourth is a solid black one.” He said, “Sell it and retain its price for your dependents. Indeed, the blessing of horses is in those possessing white markings.”

key_terms.الْيَمَنِ: Yemen, the place from which the horses were brought
key_terms.وَضَحٌ: white marking or blaze on a horse

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith say about the Prophet’s preference regarding horses and their use?
ai.summary: This hadith narrates that Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام gifted four horses to the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله, who then asked for their descriptions and designated how each should be used. It highlights the Prophet’s practical guidance regarding gifts, family provision, and his preference for horses with white markings as a sign of blessing.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2462 - And I heard him (Imam (as)) say:

Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) gifted four horses from Yemen to the Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace and blessings of Allah (swt) be upon him and his family).
He came to him and said: "O Messenger of Allah (swt), I have gifted you four horses."
The Messenger of Allah (swt) said: "Describe them."
Imam (as) replied: "They are of different colors."
The Prophet (sw) asked: "Is there one with a white blaze (wadhah)?"
Imam (as) said: "Yes."
The Prophet (sw) asked: "Is there a chestnut (ashqar) with a blaze?"
Imam (as) said: "Yes."
The Prophet (sw) said: "Keep it for me."
Then the Prophet (sw) asked: "Are there two bay (kumayt) horses with blazes?"
Imam (as) said: "Yes."
The Prophet (sw) said: "Give them to your two sons."
Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) continued: "And the fourth is a solid black (adham baheem)."
The Prophet (sw) said: "Sell it and use its price for the needs of your family. The blessing of horses lies in those with white blazes."
